description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Freudenberg Performance Materials is part of the Freudenberg Group and a leading global supplier of innovative technical textiles for a broad range of markets: From apparel, automotive, building materials, civil engineering, energy, filter media, healthcare and to building interiors and more. Join our team and shape the future of innovation with us! Discover our world at www.freudenberg-pm.com.

You support our team as CRM Aftermarket Data Specialist

Responsibilities

  • Attend the requests and status of requests generated by users of the PowerApp, Market Research – Request System;
  • Conduct research using Industrial Info Resources (IIR) database and other online sources to identify and validate the End User Site account requested;
  • Engage with employee to resolve questions or clarifications;
  • Create the C4C EU Site Account and notify the requestor;
  • Research customer account hierarchy and organization using IIR and other resources in collaboration with Global Key Account Managers;
  • Parent/child custody of SAP C4C customer accounts for Market Mapping;
  • Training & development of global Key User group who assist in creating End User Site accounts;
  • Engage with IIR representatives to clarify or correct information.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or related discipline;
  • Experience in market research and/or market intelligence;
  • Sales-related experience is preferred;
  • Familiarity with SAP C4C, account roles, and general account hierarchy/corporate structures;
  • Experience with database systems (e.g. Microsoft Access, SAP C4C, etc.);
  • Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to engage with users to clarify technical requests;
  • Proficient in English;
  • High value and priority for data accuracy and custody;
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Excel.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
